headline: Claude Maps the Bug-Hunting Workflow
lede: Claude-BugHunter turns authorized penetration testing into a disciplined sequence of reconnaissance, validation, evidence capture, and reporting. Its 83 skills and 681 vulnerability patterns give security researchers a structured playbook while keeping scope and engagement boundaries visible.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents a Method
lede: Superpowers makes an agent earn its way to implementation. Requirements discovery, design approval, test-driven execution, isolated worktrees, and review form a procedural framework for autonomous development that remains inspectable at every stage.

headline: CLI-Anything Brings Desktop Apps to Agents
lede: CLI-Anything wraps complex software in predictable, testable command-line harnesses. Through one CLI hub, agents can discover and operate tools such as Blender, Kdenlive, Obsidian, and Zotero without relying on fragile screen-level improvisation.

headline: MiniMind Teaches the Small Language Model
lede: MiniMind lays out the full construction plan for a compact language model, from tokenization and pretraining to LoRA, preference optimization, and tool use. Its roughly 64-million-parameter scale makes modern model training approachable on a consumer GPU.

headline: Cursor Plugins Connect Agents to Work
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog turns agent capabilities into installable workplace components. Standard manifests organize coding, review, orchestration, CRM, documents, and business-service integrations so teams can extend an agent without rebuilding each workflow.

headline: Firecrawl Feeds Agents the Living Web
lede: Firecrawl converts dynamic pages, documents, and browser actions into structured material that agents can use. Rendering, crawling, proxy rotation, monitoring, and batch extraction form a high-throughput path from the live web to Markdown, JSON, or searchable research context.

headline: NGINX Keeps Traffic Moving
lede: NGINX remains a disciplined edge engine: lean worker processes, modular capabilities, and text-based configuration handle serving, proxying, caching, and load balancing. It puts predictable performance between users and the systems behind them.

headline: OpenVINO Compresses the Path to Inference
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training frameworks into an optimized representation for Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs. Quantization, sparsity, serving tools, and broad APIs give deployment teams a measurable route from model artifact to efficient inference.

headline: Diagram Design Turns Prompts into Polished Systems
lede: Diagram Design transforms plain-language briefs into standalone HTML and SVG compositions across 44 diagram types. Grid alignment, overlap checks, brand-aware palettes, and editable exports give agent-generated visuals a deliberate layout instead of a default sketch.

headline: Last30days Builds Evidence from the Now
lede: Last30days assembles a recent record from social platforms, news, markets, video, developer communities, and research archives. Parallel searches and attributable supporting material turn scattered signals into a concise brief for due diligence, trend study, or preparation.
